[Venetsanos Winery](https://venetsanoswinery.com/wedding-events/) is built on four levels and has been transformed to host events and weddings.
- **Setting:** The Upper Terrace on the second level, an open-air space of 250 square metres.
- **Caldera view:** The Upper Terrace overlooks the caldera.
- **Ceremony:** The terrace hosts the ceremony, the reception, a private dinner or a gala.
- **Capacity:** About 100 seated at round tables, 160 at a standing reception, or 100 theatre style.
- **Standout:** Ceremony and dinner on one caldera terrace, without moving guests.
